prompts.title: Full-Stack DevOps
prompts.description: Full-Stack DevOps: plan, build, update, verify, review and release apps across stacks. Fill in the task and run Full-Stack DevOps in one step.
prompts.content:
# Full-Stack DevOps

Run /fsdevops and help me with the task below. Talk to me in plain words and ask only what you need from me.

* **Task:** `{{task}}`
* **Stage:** `{{stage}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`
* **Details:** `{{details}}`

If something you need is missing, ask for it in one short message, then continue.

Before you create, change, send, publish, or delete anything, show a short plan and wait for my yes. Read-only checks run without it.

task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Describe what you need in your own words.
task.context: What goes in, what should come out, and any rules it must follow.

stage.label: Stage
stage.context: Pick the step to run. Not sure: leave it on the first option and the entry skill decides. Skills: FSDevOps API Developer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-api; FSDevOps Architect = /fsdevops:fsdevops-architect; FSDevOps CI Engineer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-ci; FSDevOps Flutter Developer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-flutter; FSDevOps Maintainer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-maintainer; FSDevOps Performance Engineer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-performance; FSDevOps QA Engineer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-qa; FSDevOps Release Manager = /fsdevops:fsdevops-release; FSDevOps Reviewer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-reviewer; FSDevOps Security Engineer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-security; FSDevOps UI Developer = /fsdevops:fsdevops-designer; FSDevOps Critic = /fsdevops:fsdevops-critic.
